title: December 2027 quarterly triple witching (index futures, index options and single-stock options expire together)
source: EST: third-Friday arithmetic re-derived by this session 2026-09-08 rather than inherited -- 2027-12-01 is a Wednesday, so December 2027's Fridays are the 3rd, 10th, 17th and 24th and the THIRD FRIDAY is 2027-12-17. Corroborated independently by a reading this repo already holds: docs/research/events/fomc-2027-09-15.md leg 13 recorded Cboe's live VA listing carrying Z7 2027-12-17 among its third-Friday settlements (fetched HTTP 200 by that session), which agrees to the day. NYSE's published 2027 holiday set, recorded by the same sibling (Jan 1, Jan 18, Feb 15, Mar 26, May 31, Jun 18, Jul 5, Sep 6, Nov 25, Dec 24), puts no holiday on 2027-12-17 or the sessions around it, so no displacement of the kind that moved opex-2027-06-17 applies here. Filed estimate on the taxonomy rather than on doubt about the date: the OCC and cdn.cboe expiration-calendar primaries were logged 403 by the opex-2027-06-17 lane and were not re-attempted this session, so no expiration-calendar primary has been read for 2027-12-17 -- the date rests on arithmetic plus a sibling's Cboe reading. Discovered during the fomc-2027-12-08 initial research, checked 2026-09-08
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-2027-12-08 initial research (2026-09-08) because its adjacency sweep found a hole rather than an event. The +/-5-day corridor around a HIGH-impact FOMC decision (2027-12-03 to 2027-12-13) returned ZERO tracked events, and the reason is structural: this calendar's expiration class stops at opex-2027-10-15 and vix-expiration-2027-10-20, so December 2027 carries nothing at all. That is the same emptiness fomc-2027-09-15 found and filled for its own corridor with opex-2027-09-17 and vix-expiration-2027-09-15. THE PROPOSING LANE STATES ITS INTEREST AND THEN DISCLAIMS THE OBVIOUS INFERENCE: this expiry sits at D+9 from the 2027-12-08 decision, which is OUTSIDE expiry week, and NOTHING FOLLOWS FROM THAT GAP. fomc-2027-09-15 leg 5 tested the 'treat the decision and the expiry as one event window' corridor rule on 77 quarterly-month decision days and REFUTED IT FOR THE CLASS -- inside expiry week (gap +1..+4) n=49 mean 1.072% vs outside n=28 mean 0.844%, permutation P = 0.163, and the effect REVERSES in September. This lane does not revive it, and no future lane should re-derive it from this entry's mere existence. The proposal is a calendar-completeness fix: a December 2027 corridor with no expiration entry is a gap in the data, not a signal. ONE FURTHER CAVEAT FROM THE PROPOSER'S OWN RESEARCH, offered as context rather than as this event's research: that same lane retired the FOMC monthly decision-day base-rate table entirely -- selection-corrected, P(max of 12 monthly cells >= December's 1.265%) = 0.8212 and P at the table's true maximum, August's 1.482%, = 0.4076 -- so whoever researches this id should NOT reach for a December-specific volatility cell to size an expiry against. Use the pooled 0.925% / 0.650% or measure the expiry class on its own terms. IMPACT MEDIUM, matching the other opex-* entries in this calendar rather than asserting anything about this one. Proposed as an estimate; nothing here licenses an entry.
